يبتعثن (form VIII)
# يَبْتَعِثْنَ (yabtaʕiṯna) /jab.ta.ʕiθ.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# يُبْتَعَثْنَ (yubtaʕaṯna) /jub.ta.ʕaθ.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
